g.text: Malukshure coast and access — conditional alternative
Source supports coastal capital/cape near Sarion. Exact coordinates, shape and approach are original interpretation.
One binding choice: Sainte H → O. O is the existing gameplay mask here, not a claim of Morgdahl ownership.
Country pin is not a complete city. Harbour, streets, tower manifestation and S1E10 building condition remain open.
Active map and canonical anchors remain unchanged; candidate requires its explicitly proposed anchor binding.
